scenarios: the renderer's process is killed after a task reached review; main keeps the Core, the lease and the stream and opens a fresh window; the session snapshot (offset, generation, tasks) is unchanged, the same Core process answers the new renderer's typed requests, no model request was made by the restart
proof: the renderer is a view of the Core's session; killed and brought back, the session's truth is unchanged and the Core remains its owner.
audit: PARTIAL before: typed messages and snapshot/cursor start existed; a dead renderer stayed dead and nothing proved the truth survived.
limitations: clean exits are not brought back; transient renderer UI state is lost by design; no crash-storm limit.
